description: Defines the MinidumpDescriptor class used for configuring crash dump generation in the Google Breakpad crash reporting system, including modes for file, fd, and console microdumps.

classes.name: google_breakpad::MinidumpDescriptor
classes.description: Class representing how a crash dump should be generated, supporting file, fd, and console microdump modes.

methods.name: MinidumpDescriptor()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing to uninitialized mode.

methods.name: getMicrodumpDescriptor()
methods.description: Static method to get a default microdump descriptor.

methods.name: IsFD()
methods.description: Checks if the dump mode is file descriptor.

methods.name: directory()
methods.description: Returns the directory path for minidump.

methods.name: path()
methods.description: Returns the full path to the minidump.

methods.name: IsMicrodumpOnConsole()
methods.description: Checks if mode is console microdump.

methods.name: UpdatePath()
methods.description: Updates the dump path to be unique.

methods.name: size_limit()
methods.description: Gets the size limit for dump.

methods.name: set_size_limit(off_t limit)
methods.description: Sets the size limit for dump.

methods.name: microdump_extra_info()
methods.description: Returns pointer to extra info for microdumps.
